set: A: motion, one sheet of frames across each of the five beats, three sheets of consecutive frames at hits on the arrow, the page turn and the slab seating

issues.where: frame 1:07.03, middle of the page turn
issues.what: as the page flips, it reveals a glowing orange and purple audio-waveform landscape instead of the edge or back of the slab; at normal speed this flashes as an unrelated scene cut inside a physical turn, and you cannot tell what you are looking at without knowing it is meant to be a page
issues.fix: render the flip's interstitial as the physical slab (its thin edge and mottled back, dim and matte); if a reveal of the next page's glow is wanted, keep it framed by the slab's underside and edge so it reads as the back of the page, not a cut to another scene

issues.what: the page is seen steeply foreshortened from an oblique angle, then snaps to a dead-flat view within 0.17s; the camera is at an angle over the page (against the straight-in, straight-out rule) and the snap has no ease or weight
issues.fix: start the beat flat, or open on a slow, eased dolly that settles to the flat view over at least half a second

issues.where: the slot lever, all twelve frames (0:57.80 to 0:58.17)
issues.what: contact is one-sided: the cursor reaches the orange lever knob and coins pour out, but the lever never rotates down or springs back in any frame; a hit that makes the machine pay without the lever moving reads as broken
issues.fix: rotate the lever smoothly down through the pull across a few consecutive frames, hold the digits flipping while it is down, then let it spring back and settle

issues.what: the cursor smears into a feathered double-image with a red-orange trailing fringe while cranking; at native size the pointer is visibly unstable and chromatically ghosted
issues.fix: keep the cursor a solid white arrow at all times; if motion blur is wanted, use a mild single-image blur with no color fringe and no duplicated shape

issues.what: the whole crank and VU assembly pops away within two frames of the 100% pay-off rather than retreating mechanically; a built machine vanishes like a UI layer, killing its mass at the exact moment the viewer is watching it
issues.fix: slide or fold the assembly back into the page over at least a third of a second with a slight overshoot, so it leaves the way a heavy part would

issues.where: frame 1:06.67, just under the Volume row
issues.what: a grey brush-stroke smear appears across the dropdown for one frame and is gone again; a flicker artifact at native size
issues.fix: regenerate or patch that frame so the row matches its neighbors

issues.what: the dial's spin is soft and drifty (continuous feathered blur with no ratchet click or spring-back cadence a rotary dial has), and the cursor inflates into an oversized feathered paper-plane arrow that dwarfs it elsewhere on the page
issues.fix: give the dial a stepped, click-driven spin that snaps back under the finger, and keep the drag cursor the same size and hardness as elsewhere

issues.what: small duplicated checkmark-like cursor ghosts linger over the field in two frames; they read as leftover render ghosts
issues.fix: remove the ghost glyphs so only one clean cursor exists per frame
